jobs.description:
Für das Zentrum Forensische Psychiatrie Stationär (ZFPS) suchen wir per 01.11.2025 oder nach Vereinbarung Sie als

Aufgaben:
• Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Leitungsteams (Psychiatrie-Psychologie-Pflege/Betreuung) gestalten Sie das therapeutische Milieu und die individuelle Behandlung der Patienten auf der Sicherheitsstation KFP-1

• Sie supervidieren die psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutische Ausbildung der Assistenzärzt*in auf ihrer Station

• Bei einem Teil der Massnahmepatienten leiten Sie die Therapie unter hoch gesicherten Bedingungen ein.

• Sie führen stationäre Abklärungen zu differenzialdiagnostischen Fragen und zur Frage der Behandelbarkeit psychisch kranker Straftäter durch.

• Im Rahmen stationärer Akutbehandlungen von Gefängnisinsassen arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Psychiatrisch-Psychologischen Dienst (PPD) der JVA Lenzburg und dem Gesundheitsdienst der Aargauer Gefängnisse zusammen.

• Bei Interesse besteht die Möglichkeit zur Lehrtätigkeit an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz (FHNW) und zur Erstellung strafrechtlicher Gutachten

Anforderungen:
• Sie verfügen über eine Facharztanerkennung in Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie oder sind in der Facharztweiterbildung fortgeschritten

• Ihre Haltung gegenüber straffälligen Menschen ist wertschätzend und risikobewusst

• Sie interessieren sich für eine moderne, integrative forensisch-psychiatrische Behandlung

• Sie arbeiten gern in interdisziplinären Teams

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel:

Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt.

Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il Centro di Psichiatria Forense Degenti (ZFPS) ti cerchiamo per incarichi dal 1 novembre 2025 o su appuntamento:
• Nell'ambito di un team di gestione interdisciplinare (psichiatria-psicologia-infermieristica/supporto), progetterai l'ambiente terapeutico e il trattamento individuale dei pazienti nel reparto di sicurezza KFP-1
• Lei supervisiona la formazione psichiatrica-psicoterapeutica del medico in formazione del suo reparto
• Per alcuni pazienti in cura la terapia viene iniziata in condizioni di massima sicurezza.
• Effettuate valutazioni ospedaliere su questioni diagnostiche differenziali e sulla questione della trattabilità dei delinquenti malati di mente.
• Nell'ambito del trattamento ospedaliero acuto dei detenuti lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con il Servizio psichiatrico-psicologico (PPD) dell'ACC di Lenzburg e con il servizio sanitario delle carceri argoviesi.
• Se sei interessato, hai la possibilità di insegnare alla Scuola universitaria professionale della Svizzera nordoccidentale (FHNW) e di preparare perizie di diritto penale. Requisiti:
• Possiedi una qualifica specialistica in psichiatria e psicoterapia o hai una formazione avanzata come specialista
• Il tuo atteggiamento nei confronti dei delinquenti è riconoscente e consapevole del rischio
• Sei interessato a un trattamento psichiatrico forense moderno e integrativo
• Ti piace lavorare in team interdisciplinari. Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Proprio per questo ti offriamo molto: incoraggiamo fortemente la formazione continua. Investiamo molto anche nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Offriamo anche sconti interessanti su marchi rinomati come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che si spostano da noi con i mezzi pubblici ricevono a fine anno un impressionante ecobonus. Offriamo anche un'interessante soluzione di cassa pensione. Promuoviamo inoltre l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo la possibilità di acquistare una vacanza.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For the Inpatient Forensic Psychiatry Center (ZFPS) we are looking for you as tasks as of November 1st, 2025 or by appointment:
• As part of an interdisciplinary management team (psychiatry-psychology-nursing/support), you will design the therapeutic environment and the individual treatment of the patients on the KFP-1 security ward
• You supervise the psychiatric-psychotherapeutic training of the junior doctor on your ward
• For some of the patients undergoing treatment, you initiate therapy under highly secure conditions.
• You carry out inpatient assessments on differential diagnostic questions and the question of the treatability of mentally ill offenders.
• As part of the acute inpatient treatment of prison inmates, you will work closely with the Psychiatric-Psychological Service (PPD) of the Lenzburg JVA and the health service of the Aargau prisons.
• If you are interested, you have the opportunity to teach at the University of Applied Sciences Northwestern Switzerland (FHNW) and to prepare criminal law reports. Requirements:
• You have a specialist qualification in psychiatry and psychotherapy or have advanced further training as a specialist
• Your attitude towards delinquents is appreciative and risk-aware
• You are interested in modern, integrative forensic psychiatric treatment
• You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

jobs.description:
Sie möchten in der Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie tätig sein?
In unserer Klinik für Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie, Psychosomatik und Psychotherapie bieten wir fortlaufend vielfältige und spannende Einsatzmöglichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten (Windisch, Aarau, Baden, Rheinfelden, Wohlen). Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam zu entdecken, welcher Einsatzbereich und welches Arbeitsumfeld am besten zu Ihrer Vorerfahrung, Ihrem Ausbildungsfortschritt und Ihren persönlichen Präferenzen passen. Aufgaben: • Sie arbeiten in multiprofessionellen Teams im stationären, teilstationären, ambulanten oder K&L Bereich • Unter qualifizierter Anleitung lernen Sie Patientinnen und Patienten mit allen kinder- und jugendpsychiatrischen Krankheitsbildern selbständig abzuklären und zu behandeln • Sie erlernen kinder- und jugendpsychiatrische Diagnostik und wesentliche psychologische Testverfahren und führen unter supervisorischer Begleitung und fachärztlicher Endverantwortung Psychoedukation, psychopharmakologische Einstellungen, Beratungen und Psychotherapien durch • Sie stellen Diagnosen und treffen Beurteilungen nach dem gültigen Diagnoseschema und arbeiten darauf aufbauend eine leitliniengerechte Massnahmenplanung aus • Sie nehmen an Notfall-Pikettdiensten der Klinik teil • Sie erstellen die notwendigen Behandlungsdokumentationen und Arztbriefe und verrechnen die erbrachten Leistungen vollständig Anforderungen: • Sie verfügen über ein Eidgenössisches Arztdiplom oder über einen äquivalenten von der MEBEKO anerkannten Studienabschluss in Medizin • Sie haben idealerweise Vorerfahrung in Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie, Psychiatrie oder Pädiatrie • Sie besitzen gute klinische Kompetenzen, Beziehungsfähigkeit, analytisches Denkvermögen sowie gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse • Sie zeigen im klinischen Alltag Belastbarkeit und Initiative und verfügen über gute Umgangsformen und Humor Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi lavorare in psichiatria infantile e adolescente? Nella nostra clinica per la psichiatria infantile e adolescente, la psicosomatica e la psicoterapia, offriamo continuamente applicazioni diverse ed emozionanti in varie località (Windisch, Aarau, Baden, Rheinfelden, Wohlen). Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione e scoprire insieme quale area di applicazione e ambiente di lavoro meglio si adattano alla vostra esperienza precedente, il vostro progresso di formazione e le vostre preferenze personali. Compiti:
• Lavorate in team multiprofessionali nella zona stazionaria, semistazione, ambulatoria o K&L
• Sotto una guida qualificata, imparerai a chiarire in modo indipendente e trattare i pazienti con tutte le malattie psichiatrici del bambino e dell'adolescente
• Imparano la diagnostica psichiatrica infantile e adolescente e le procedure di test psicologici essenziali e effettuano psicoeducazione, atteggiamenti psicofarmacologici, consulenza e psicoterapie sotto supervisione e responsabilità finale specialistica.
• Fanno diagnosi e fanno valutazioni secondo il valido schema diagnostico e, in base a questo, sviluppano un piano d'azione orientato alla linea guida.
• Partecipate ai servizi ospedalieri di emergenza
• Preparare la documentazione di trattamento necessaria e le lettere del medico e fatturare i servizi forniti completamente Requisiti
• Hai un diploma medico federale o un diploma equivalente in medicina riconosciuto da MEBEKO
• È idealmente avere esperienza precedente in psichiatria infantile e adolescente, psichiatria o pediatrica
• Hai buone capacità cliniche, capacità relazionali, capacità di pensiero analitico e buona conoscenza orale e scritta del tedesco
• Mostrano resistenza e iniziativa nella vita quotidiana clinica e hanno buone maniere e umorismo Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Ecco perché vi offriamo molto: L'istruzione superiore è fortemente incoraggiata qui. Investiamo anche fortemente nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Inoltre, offriamo interessanti sconti per marchi noti come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che ci commutano con i mezzi pubblici riceveranno un bel eco-bonus alla fine dell'anno. Inoltre, offriamo una soluzione di fondo pensione attraente. Promuoviamo anche l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa: Siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo l'opportunità di acquistare vacanze.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Would you like to work in child and adolescent psychiatry? In our clinic for child and adolescent psychiatry, psychosomatics and psychotherapy, we continuously offer diverse and exciting applications at various locations (Windisch, Aarau, Baden, Rheinfelden, Wohlen). We look forward to your application and to discover together which area of application and working environment best fit your previous experience, your training progress and your personal preferences. Tasks:
• You work in multi-professional teams in the stationary, semi-stationary, ambulatory or K&L area
• Under qualified guidance, you will learn to independently clarify and treat patients with all child and adolescent psychiatric diseases
• They learn child and adolescent psychiatric diagnostics and essential psychological testing procedures and carry out psychoeducation, psychopharmacological attitudes, counselling and psychotherapies under supervised supervision and specialist final responsibility.
• They make diagnoses and make assessments according to the valid diagnostic scheme and, based on this, develop a guideline-oriented action plan.
• You are participating in emergency hospital services
• You prepare the necessary treatment documentation and doctor’s letters and bill the services provided completely Requirements
• You have a Federal Medical Diploma or an equivalent degree in medicine recognised by MEBEKO
• You ideally have previous experience in child and adolescent psychiatry, psychiatry or pediatrics
• You have good clinical skills, relationship skills, analytical thinking skills as well as good oral and written knowledge of German
• They show resilience and initiative in clinical everyday life and have good manners and humor We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. This is why we offer you a lot: Further education is strongly encouraged here. We also invest heavily in team cohesion and offer all our teams access to the software "Moodtalk", which strengthens team communication. In addition, we offer attractive discounts for well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport will receive a handsome eco-bonus at the end of the year. In addition, we offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy holidays.

Aimeriez-vous travailler dans la psychiatrie des enfants et des adolescents ? Dans notre clinique pour la psychiatrie des enfants et des adolescents, la psychosomatique et la psychothérapie, nous offrons continuellement des applications variées et passionnantes à différents endroits (Windisch, Aarau, Baden, Rheinfelden, Wohlen). Nous nous réjouissons de votre application et de découvrir ensemble quel domaine d'application et d'environnement de travail correspond le mieux à votre expérience précédente, à vos progrès de formation et à vos préférences personnelles. Tâches :
• Vous travaillez dans des équipes multiprofessionnelles dans la zone stationnaire, semi-stationnaire, ambulatoire ou K&L
• Sous une orientation qualifiée, vous apprendrez à clarifier et à traiter de manière indépendante les patients atteints de toutes les maladies psychiatriques chez les enfants et les adolescents
• Ils apprennent les diagnostics psychiatriques des enfants et des adolescents et les procédures essentielles de dépistage psychologique et effectuent la psychoéducation, les attitudes psychopharmacologiques, les conseils et les psychothérapies sous supervision et responsabilité finale de spécialistes.
• Ils effectuent des diagnostics et des évaluations selon le schéma de diagnostic valide et, sur cette base, élaborent un plan d'action orienté vers les lignes directrices.
• Vous participez aux services hospitaliers d'urgence
• Vous préparez les documents de traitement nécessaires et les lettres du médecin et facturez les services fournis complètement Exigences
• Vous avez un diplôme de médecine fédéral ou un diplôme équivalent en médecine reconnu par MEBEKO
• Idéalement, vous avez une expérience antérieure en psychiatrie, en psychiatrie ou en pédiatrie.
• Vous avez de bonnes compétences cliniques, des compétences en relation, des compétences en pensée analytique ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance orale et écrite de l'allemand
• Ils montrent la résilience et l'initiative dans la vie quotidienne clinique et ont de bonnes manières et l'humour Nous offrons: Nos employés sont au cœur de notre entreprise. C'est pourquoi nous vous offrons beaucoup: La formation continue est fortement encouragée ici. Nous investissons également massivement dans la cohésion d'équipe et offrons à toutes nos équipes un accès au logiciel "Moodtalk", qui renforce la communication d'équipe. En outre, nous offrons des réductions intéressantes pour des marques bien connues telles que Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl et bien d'autres. Les employés qui voyagent vers nous en transport public recevront un bel éco-bonus à la fin de l'année. En outre, nous offrons une solution attrayante de fonds de pension. Nous favorisons également l'équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle : Nous sommes toujours ouverts au travail à temps partiel et offrons la possibilité d'acheter des vacances.

• Partecipate ai servizi di picchetto nell'ambito del concetto di prestazione PDAG Requisiti:
• avete o state per ricevere un riconoscimento specialistico in psichiatria e psicoterapia

descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our team in the outpatient clinic of the Center for Addiction Disorders, we are looking for a committed personality at the Aarau location with immediate effect or by appointment for the position as tasks:
• You will independently carry out outpatient psychiatric-psychotherapeutic assessments and treatments for adults with addiction disorders. You will also take comorbid mental illnesses into account
• You will take on leadership responsibility for a small, multi-professional treatment team
• Your tasks will include supervising the specialist psychologists who work on a delegated basis under your supervision
• You will actively participate in the further training of the interdisciplinary team and contribute to the further development of treatment concepts
• You will promote networking between outpatient and inpatient services as well as the upstream and downstream departments of the addiction support system. The aim is to provide integrated and needs-oriented treatment for people with addictions
• You take part in on-call services as part of the PDAG service concept Requirements:
• You have or are about to receive specialist recognition for psychiatry and psychotherapy
• Entry in the medical professions register (MedReg) is mandatory
• You have very good knowledge of German, at least at level C1
• Ideally, you have experience in the treatment of addictions and in an outpatient setting
• You are committed to a variety of things, motivating, enthusiastic, independent and make decisions confidently
• You are characterized by organizational skills, good communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary and networked collaboration. We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

Die PDAG unterstützt die Weiterbildung zum Facharzt mit einem Budget in Höhe von CHF 6'000 und 20 Weiterbildungstagen pro Kalenderjahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung bieten wir eine Position als Aufgaben: • Eigenständige psychiatrische Diagnostik und Behandlung von Patientinnen und Patienten aus dem Spektrum der Erwachsenenpsychiatrie mit Fokus auf Abhängigkeitserkrankungen. Dabei erfolgt eine oberärztliche Unterstützung • Selbstständige Erstellung medizinischer Berichte und Dokumentation • Erstellung von zivilrechtlichen Gutachten unter kaderärztlicher Anleitung • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Organisationen sowie niedergelassenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen • An einzelnen Wochenendtagen tagsüber Beteiligung am Konsiliardienst in den Spitälern des Kantons (Pikettdienst) oder am Notfalldienst im Zentrum für integrierte Notfallpsychiatrie und Krisenintervention Anforderungen: Eidgenössisches Arztdiplom oder von der MEBEKO anerkanntes ausländisches Diplom in Humanmedizin • Deutsche Muttersprache oder sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, mindestens auf Sprachniveau C1 • Berufserfahrung in Psychiatrie/Psychotherapie oder Somatik ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung • Interesse an der Behandlung von Menschen mit Abhängigkeitserkrankungen einschliesslich komorbider psychischer Erkrankungen • Belastbarkeit, Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Teamorientierung und vertieftes Interesse an der sich rasch entwickelnden Disziplin Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per supportare il nostro team medico del Centro per le dipendenze di Baden cerchiamo un successore per il nostro ambulatorio. Soddisfiamo i requisiti della Categoria A per due anni e puoi completare con noi l'intero periodo focalizzato sui disturbi da dipendenza. Il PDAG sostiene la formazione continua per diventare specialista con un budget di 6000 franchi e 20 giorni di formazione per anno civile con un carico di lavoro del 100%. Offriamo un posto immediato o su appuntamento con i seguenti compiti:
• Diagnosi psichiatrica indipendente e trattamento di pazienti dello spettro della psichiatria dell'adulto con particolare attenzione ai disturbi da dipendenza. Viene offerto supporto medico senior
• Preparazione indipendente di referti e documentazione medica
• Preparazione di rapporti di diritto civile sotto la supervisione di medici senior
• Collaborazione interdisciplinare con organizzazioni interne ed esterne e con colleghi affermati
• Partecipazione al servizio di consulenza negli ospedali cantonali durante il giorno nei singoli giorni del fine settimana (servizio di picchetto) o al servizio d'emergenza nel centro per la psichiatria d'emergenza integrata e l'intervento in crisi Requisiti: diploma di medico federale o straniero riconosciuto da MEBEKO Diploma di medicina umana
• Lingua madre tedesca o ottimo tedesco scritto e parlato, a almeno al livello linguistico C1
• L'esperienza professionale in psichiatria/psicoterapia o somatica è un vantaggio, ma non un requisito
• Interesse per il trattamento di persone con dipendenze, comprese malattie mentali comorbili
• Resilienza, capacità di comunicazione, nonché orientamento al team e profondo interesse per la disciplina in rapido sviluppo della psichiatria e della psicoterapia Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Proprio per questo ti offriamo molto: incoraggiamo fortemente la formazione continua. Investiamo molto anche nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Offriamo anche sconti interessanti su marchi rinomati come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che si spostano da noi con i mezzi pubblici ricevono a fine anno un impressionante ecobonus. Offriamo anche un'interessante soluzione di cassa pensione. Promuoviamo inoltre l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo la possibilità di acquistare una vacanza.
descriptionByLocale.en:
To support our medical team at the Center for Addiction Disorders in Baden, we are looking for a successor for our outpatient department. We meet the Category A requirement for two years and you can complete the entire time with us for the focus on addiction disorders. The PDAG supports further training to become a specialist with a budget of CHF 6,000 and 20 training days per calendar year with a workload of 100%. We offer a position immediately or by appointment with the following tasks:
• Independent psychiatric diagnosis and treatment of patients from the spectrum of adult psychiatry with a focus on addiction disorders. Senior medical support is provided
• Independent preparation of medical reports and documentation
• Preparation of civil law reports under the supervision of senior doctors
• Interdisciplinary cooperation with internal and external organizations as well as established colleagues
• Participation in the consultation service in the canton's hospitals during the day on individual weekend days (on-call service) or in the emergency service in the center for integrated emergency psychiatry and crisis intervention Requirements: Federal medical diploma or foreign one recognized by MEBEKO Diploma in human medicine
• German native language or very good written and spoken German, at least at language level C1
• Professional experience in psychiatry/psychotherapy or somatics is an advantage, but not a requirement
• Interest in the treatment of people with addictions, including comorbid mental illnesses
• Resilience, communication skills as well as team orientation and deep interest in the rapidly developing discipline of psychiatry and psychotherapy We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

Rafael Meyer è responsabile per la cura psichiatrica di persone di età superiore ai 65 anni e persone con disordine intellettuale di sviluppo, nonché per il supporto psichiatrico consiliare di ospedali e case nel cantone di Aargau. Per una delle nostre cinque fermate a Windisch siamo alla ricerca di voi come compiti su appuntamento:
• Lavorano sotto la direzione e la supervisione di un medico catare su uno dei ward psichiatrici adulti (adulti 65+) o sull'unità di cura acuta per le persone con disabilità di sviluppo intellettuale (adulti 18+)
• Trattano pazienti anziani con una vasta gamma di malattie psichiatriche (psicosi, disturbi affettivi, demenza e altri disturbi neurocognitivi, tra gli altri) o persone con disabilità intellettuale e con disturbi mentali
• Diagnosi integrata basata sulla prova e terapia nel quadro del concetto operativo e processi standardizzati secondo gli standard professionali
• Documentazione e preparazione dei rapporti strutturati
• Partecipazione ai rapporti interdisciplinari
• Interessi nella psichiatria di vecchiaia e neuropsichiatria (65+) o nelle persone con disabilità intellettuale e concomorbite mentali (18+)
• Interessi nella cura psichiatrica delle persone con psichiatria comorbida e patologia somatica, la cui complessità complica i processi di trattamento

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Clinic for Consultant, Geriatric and Neuropsychiatry (KAN, a.i. clinic director Dr. med. Rafael Meyer) is responsible for the psychiatric care of people over 65 years of age and people with intellectual developmental disabilities as well as for the consultant psychiatric support of hospitals and homes in the canton of Aargau. By appointment, we are looking for you for one of our five wards in Windisch as tasks:
• You work under the direction and supervision of a senior doctor on one of the geriatric psychiatric wards (adults 65+) or in the acute ward for people with intellectual development disorders (adults 18+)
• You treat older patients with a wide range of psychiatric illnesses (psychoses, affective disorders, dementia and other neurocognitive disorders, etc.) or people with intellectual disabilities impairment and with mental disorders
• Evidence-based integrated diagnostics and therapy within the framework of the operational concept and the standardized processes in accordance with professional standards
• Careful structured case documentation and creation of reports

Aufgaben:
• Gewährleistung einer qualitativ hochstehenden und zeitgemässen psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutischen Versorgung auf der Grundlage von gesetzlichen und betrieblichen Rahmenbedingungen sowie Fachempfehlungen (stationär, aufsuchend und ambulant)

• Führung des multiprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Werte und Führungsgrundsätze der PDAG

• Gewährleistung der Zielerreichung aktueller Jahresziele sowie weiterer quantitativen und qualitativen Ziele der Organisationseinheit

• Gewährleistung einer sorgfältigen strukturierten Falldokumentation

• Gewährleistung der fachlichen Weiterbildung bzw. des "on-the-job Training" der unterstellten Mitarbeitenden sowie Weiterbildungssupervisionen

• Zusammenarbeit im multiprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Team

• Mitwirkung an Aus-, Weiter- und Fortbildungsangeboten der PDAG

• Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Netzwerkpflege im Kontext unterschiedlicher Anlässe

• Mitwirkung an Projekten, Aufträgen und Anpassungen gemäss Klinikleitung

• Mitwirkung im Dienstsystem PDAG

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum Facharzttitel Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie

• Interesse am Spezialbereich Entwicklungs- und Neuropsychiatrie

• Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Hohe Sozialkompetenzen, selbständiger und effizienter Arbeitsstil sowie hohe Belastbarkeit

• Freude an der multiprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit

• Identifikation mit unseren Unternehmenswerten: Mut, Engagement und Vertrauen

• Sehr gute Führungskompetenzen (CAS Leadership)

• Strategische und betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenzen

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel:

Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt.

Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il nostro centro unico in Svizzera di neuropsichiatria dello sviluppo e neuropsichiatria (trattamenti per persone con disabilità dello sviluppo intellettivo 18+), nell'attraente sede di Windisch, cerchiamo un adeguato rinforzo a settembre o come concordato. I nostri compiti sono:
• Garantire un'assistenza psichiatrica e psicoterapeutica moderna e di alta qualità sulla base delle condizioni quadro legali e operative nonché delle raccomandazioni specialistiche (stazionarie, ambulatoriali e ambulatoriali)
• Guidare il team multiprofessionale e interdisciplinare, tenendo conto dei valori e dei principi gestionali della PDAG
• Garantire il raggiungimento degli attuali obiettivi annuali e di altri obiettivi quantitativi e qualitativi dell'unità organizzativa
• Garantire una documentazione attenta e strutturata dei casi
• Garantire la formazione professionale continua o la "formazione sul posto di lavoro" dei dipendenti subordinati nonché l'assistenza alla formazione continua
• Collaborazione in un team multiprofessionale e interdisciplinare
• Partecipazione alle offerte di formazione, perfezionamento e perfezionamento della PDAG
• Relazioni pubbliche e mantenimento della rete nell'ambito di diverse occasioni
• Partecipazione a progetti, ordini e adattamenti in base alla direzione della clinica
• Partecipazione al sistema di servizi PDAG Requisiti:
• Completamento della formazione continua per diventare specialista in psichiatria e psicoterapia
• Interesse per l'area specialistica di sviluppo e psicoterapia Neuropsichiatria
• Senso di responsabilità, affidabilità e capacità di lavorare in squadra
• Elevate competenze sociali, stile di lavoro indipendente ed efficiente nonché elevata resilienza
• Piacere della collaborazione multiprofessionale e interdisciplinare
• Identificazione con i nostri valori aziendali: coraggio, impegno e fiducia
• Ottime capacità di leadership (CAS Leadership)
• Capacità di gestione strategica e aziendale Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Proprio per questo ti offriamo molto: incoraggiamo fortemente la formazione continua. Investiamo molto anche nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Offriamo anche sconti interessanti su marchi rinomati come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che si spostano da noi con i mezzi pubblici ricevono a fine anno un impressionante ecobonus. Offriamo anche un'interessante soluzione di cassa pensione. Promuoviamo inoltre l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo la possibilità di acquistare una vacanza.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For our center for developmental and neuropsychiatry (treatments for people with intellectual developmental disabilities 18+), which is unique in Switzerland, at the attractive location in Windisch, we are looking for suitable reinforcement in September or as agreed. Our tasks will be:
• Ensuring high-quality and contemporary psychiatric-psychotherapeutic care based on legal and operational framework conditions as well as specialist recommendations (inpatient, outpatient and outpatient)
• Leading the multi-professional and interdisciplinary team, taking values into account and management principles of the PDAG
• Ensuring the achievement of current annual goals as well as other quantitative and qualitative goals of the organizational unit
• Ensuring careful, structured case documentation
• Ensuring professional further training or the "on-the-job training" of the subordinate employees as well as further training supervision
• Collaboration in a multi-professional and interdisciplinary team
• Participation in PDAG training, further education and training offers
• Public relations and network maintenance in the context of various occasions
• Participation in projects, orders and adjustments according to the clinic management
• Participation in the PDAG service system Requirements:
• Completed further training to become a specialist in psychiatry and psychotherapy
• Interest in the specialist area of developmental and psychotherapy Neuropsychiatry
• Sense of responsibility, reliability and ability to work in a team
• High social skills, independent and efficient working style as well as high resilience
• Enjoyment of multi-professional and interdisciplinary collaboration
• Identification with our company values: courage, commitment and trust
• Very good leadership skills (CAS Leadership)
• Strategic and business management skills We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

jobs.description:
In der Abteilung für interventionelle Psychiatrie werden Elektrokonvulsionstherapien (EKT) in Kurznarkose durchgeführt. Die Vorbereitung und die Nachbetreuung der EKT-Patienten werden im Aufwachraum vorgenommen. Ebenso bieten wir Behandlungen mit repetitiver transkranieller Magnetstimulation (rTMS) an sowie Behandlungen mit Esketamin.

Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Person zur Mitarbeit im Aufwachraum. Wiedereinsteigerinnen und Wiedereinsteiger sind Herzlich Willkommen. Aufgaben: • Sie betreuen und überwachen unsere ambulanten und stationären Patienten im Aufwachraum vor und nach der EKT und gestalten so deren Genesungsprozess aktiv mit • Zu Ihren Tätigkeiten gehört das Anlegen venöser Zugänge, wobei eine Weiterbildung in diesem Bereich möglich ist, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern • Ihr medizinisches Wissen wenden Sie bei der eigenverantwortlichen Durchführung ärztlich verordneter Massnahmen an • Sie sind geschult darin, Notfallsituationen und Komplikationen frühzeitig zu erkennen und adäquat zu handeln Anforderungen: • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau / Dipl. Pflegefachmann HF oder Fachfrau / Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ • Sie bringen Freude am Patientenkontakt mit und schätzen den Austausch mit Menschen • Ihre Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit helfen Ihnen dabei, auch in herausfordernden Situationen einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren • Sie arbeiten selbstständig und zügig • Sie präsentieren sich als Teamplayer Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel Dipartimento di Psichiatria Intervenzionale, le terapie di elettroconvulsione (EKT) vengono eseguite in breve anestesia. La preparazione e il follow-up dei pazienti ECT è effettuata nella sala di recupero. Offriamo anche trattamenti ripetitivi di stimolazione magnetica transcraniale (rTMS) e di esketamina. Stiamo cercando una persona impegnata a lavorare nella sala di recupero immediatamente o con accordo. I re-entrants sono i benvenuti. Compiti: Si prende cura e monitorare i nostri pazienti ambulatoriali e malati nella sala di recupero prima e dopo ECT e quindi modellare attivamente il loro processo di recupero Le vostre attività includono la creazione di accessi venosi, con ulteriore formazione in questo settore possibile espandere la vostra competenza
• Si applica la vostra conoscenza medica per l'attuazione responsabile di misure mediche prescritte
• Essi sono formati per identificare situazioni di emergenza e complicazioni in una fase precoce e per agire in modo appropriato Requisiti: Hai completato l'allenamento come Dipl. Infermieristica professionale / Dipl. Specialista infermieristica HF o specialista salute EFZ
• Portano gioia al contatto paziente e apprezzano lo scambio con le persone
• La vostra flessibilità e resilienza vi aiuterà a mantenere una testa fresca anche in situazioni difficili
• Lavori in modo indipendente e veloce
• Si presentano come giocatori di squadra Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Questo è proprio il motivo per cui vi offriamo molto: ulteriore istruzione è fortemente promossa qui. Investiamo anche molto nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Inoltre, offriamo interessanti sconti per marchi noti come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che ci commutano con i mezzi pubblici riceveranno un bel eco-bonus alla fine dell'anno. Inoltre, offriamo una soluzione di fondo pensione attraente. Promuoviamo anche l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa: Siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo l'opportunità di acquistare vacanze.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In the Department of Interventional Psychiatry, electroconvulsion therapies (EKT) are performed in short anesthesia. The preparation and follow-up of the ECT patients is carried out in the recovery room. We also offer repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and esketamine treatments. We are looking for a committed person to work in the recovery room immediately or by agreement. Re-entrants are welcome. Tasks: You look after and monitor our ambulatory and inpatient patients in the recovery room before and after ECT and thus actively shape their recovery process Your activities include creating venous accesses, with further training in this area possible to expand your expertise
• You apply your medical knowledge to the self-responsible implementation of medically prescribed measures
• They are trained to identify emergency situations and complications at an early stage and to act appropriately Requirements: You have completed training as a Dipl. Nursing professional / Dipl. Nursing specialist HF or specialist health EFZ
• They bring joy to patient contact and appreciate the exchange with people
• Your flexibility and resilience will help you keep a cool head even in challenging situations
• You work independently and quickly
• They present themselves as team players We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. This is precisely why we offer you a lot: further education is strongly promoted here. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all our teams access to the software "Moodtalk", which strengthens team communication. In addition, we offer attractive discounts for well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport will receive a handsome eco-bonus at the end of the year. In addition, we offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy holidays.

jobs.description:
Für die Bereiche des Home Treatments sowie der Zentralen Anmeldung der Klinik für Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie, Psychosomatik und Psychotherapie suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Sie als

Aufgaben:
• Sie arbeiten unter anderem aufsuchend im interdisziplinären Team in der Beratung von psychisch kranken Kindern, Jugendlichen und deren Familien im Auftrag der fallführenden Therapeutinnen und Therapeuten

• Sie vertreten die sozialarbeiterische Expertise im multiprofessionellen Behandlungsteam

• Zusammenarbeit und Vernetzung mit Behörden, Ämtern und Institutionen

• Eigenverantwortliche Koordination von Hilfeleistungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit Institutionen, Behörden, Mandatsträgern und Angehörigen mit dem Ziel der Begrenzung nachteiliger Folgen einer psychischen Erkrankung

• Suche nach geeigneten Anschlusslösungen sowie Austrittsplanung in Zusammenarbeit mit den Patienten und weiteren Personen

jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Sie als

Aufgaben:

For our autism specialist center in Aarau, we are looking for you immediately or by appointment as tasks:
• You will take on the personnel and professional management of the autism specialist center (in co-management with the senior psychologist and the head of special education).
• You lead the clinical staff to assess patients with suspected autism spectrum disorders (ASD), advise their parents and carers and, if necessary, treat them.
• They instruct common psychological testing procedures and carry out psychopharmacological adjustments, consultations and treatments.
• You make diagnoses and assessments according to the valid diagnostic scheme and work out an action plan based on this.
• You participate in the background emergency service of the Clinic for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Psychotherapy.
• You ensure that your colleagues at your management level represent each other in the event of absences.
• You will work with the management of the center for outpatient triage, crisis interventions and special consultations as well as other KJP departments and external partners. Requirements:
• You have a specialist title in child and adolescent psychiatry and psychotherapy FMH, are about to complete it, or have an equivalent MEBEKO-recognized qualification.
• Ideally, you have management experience and management training or are prepared to complete such.
• You enjoy interdisciplinary and guideline-oriented work and promote it accordingly.
• You are motivated to provide the most efficient possible assessment and treatment of children and young people with the involvement of their families.
• You are characterized by your own initiative, high social skills and situation-appropriate communication as well as flexibility and resilience.
• You have a humorous personality, both in everyday life and in dynamic situations, and therefore complement our team ideally. We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

For the Inpatient Forensic Psychiatry Center (ZFPS), we are looking for you immediately or by appointment as the following:
• You are committed to interdisciplinary collaboration and promote the framework conditions for implementing the treatment concept
• You are jointly responsible for the professional, organizational and administrative management of the care team, consisting of nurses, social educators, employees with correctional qualifications and health specialists
• You assume joint responsibility for the further development of forensics Station, bring your expertise, among other things. in the design of the milieu therapy, and represent the ward and the company both internally and externally
• You take responsibility for the future-oriented support and development of the department's employees with regard to the ward's mission and the company's goals
• You work on a ward with a group setting, treat and look after patients for measures, crime prevention and rehabilitative
• You ensure the well-being of our patients in a three-shift system
• You are jointly responsible for the training of learners as part of the training assignment Requirements:
• You have completed training as a Dipl. HF/FH nursing specialist and preferably have professional experience in psychiatry
• You are willing to complete the CAS Leadership
• Your attitude towards delinquent people is risk-conscious and appreciative
• You enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team
• You have exceptionally high social skills
• You have strong communication skills
• You are characterized by a very high level of self-reflection and critical ability We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. That's exactly why we offer you a lot: we strongly encourage further training. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all of our teams access to the “Moodtalk” software, which strengthens team communication. We also offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy a holiday.

Für die neuropsychiatrische Akutstation sucht unser sehr gut eingespieltes und humorvolles Team per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, Sie als Aufgaben: • Stationäre Akutpflege von Menschen mit einer intellektuellen Entwicklungsstörung mit verschiedenen psychiatrischen Krankheitsbildern in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem hochqualifizierten inter-disziplinären Team • Sie tragen Mitverantwortung für die Umsetzung der therapeutischen, pflegerischen und pädagogischen Massnahmen • Dank frühzeitiger Planung im Schichtbetrieb haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Freizeit sowie die Arbeitseinsätze vorausschauend zu planen Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau / Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ, von Vorteil mit Erfahrung in der Psychiatrie, Akutgeriatrie, Akutmedizin oder mit Menschen mit intellektuellen Entwicklungsstörungen • Bereitschaft und Interesse, sich in ein hochspezialisiertes Behandlungskonzept einzuarbeiten und dieses weiterzuentwickeln • Starke Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Sozial – und Selbstkompetenz, sowie Freude an komplexen Herausforderungen Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous prêt à relever un défi unique ? Pour le service de soins aigus neuropsychiatriques, notre équipe très bien rodée et pleine d'humour vous recherche immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous pour les tâches suivantes :
• Soins aigus hospitaliers de personnes atteintes d'un trouble du développement intellectuel avec diverses maladies psychiatriques en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe interdisciplinaire hautement qualifiée
• Vous partagez la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre des mesures thérapeutiques, infirmières et éducatives
• Grâce à la planification précoce du travail posté, vous avez la possibilité de planifier à l'avance votre temps libre et vos tâches de travail. Exigences :
• Formation complète en tant que spécialiste de la santé EFZ, un avantage avec une expérience en psychiatrie, gériatrie aiguë, médecine aiguë ou auprès de personnes ayant une déficience intellectuelle du développement
• Volonté et intérêt de se familiariser avec un concept de traitement hautement spécialisé et de le développer davantage
• Forte personnalité avec une forte compétence sociale et personnelle, ainsi que le plaisir de relever des défis complexes Nous proposons : Nos employés sont le cœur de notre entreprise. C'est exactement pourquoi nous vous proposons beaucoup : nous encourageons fortement la formation continue. Nous investissons également beaucoup dans la cohésion d’équipe et proposons à toutes nos équipes l’accès au logiciel « Moodtalk » qui renforce la communication en équipe. Nous proposons également des réductions intéressantes sur des marques connues telles que Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl et bien d'autres encore. Les collaborateurs qui se rendent chez nous en transports en commun reçoivent un éco-bonus impressionnant à la fin de l'année. Nous proposons également une solution de prévoyance attractive. Nous promouvons également l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée : nous sommes toujours ouverts au travail à temps partiel et offrons la possibilité d'acheter des vacances.

• Dispensing substitution medication
• Accompanying our patients in the care process within the caregiver system

Employees who commute to us by public transport receive an impressive eco-bonus at the end of the year. We also offer an attractive pension fund solution. jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unserer Teams in den Ambulatorien Aarau oder Rheinfelden der Klinik für Kinder und Jugendpsychiatrie und -psychotherapie suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Sie als

Aufgaben:
• Sie arbeiten in einem engagierten interdisziplinären Team des Ambulatoriums gemäss institutioneller Zielsetzung

• Sie übernehmen selbständig die Fallführung und führen Abklärungen, Psychotherapien, Kriseninterventionen und Beratungen bei psychisch belasteten Kindern und Jugendlichen und deren Familien durch

• Sie führen psychiatrisch-psychologische Abklärungen mit den gängigen Instrumenten durch (psychopathologische Befunderhebung, Testpsychologie, Anamnese, Drittauskünfte)

• Sie erstellen Diagnosen und Beurteilungen nach dem gültigen Diagnoseschema und arbeiten darauf aufbauend eine Massnahmenplanung gemäss fachlich etablierten, leitliniengerechten Methoden und unter Berücksichtigung individueller Gegebenheit der Kinder/Jugendlichen aus

• Sie erstellen die notwendigen Behandlungsdokumentationen und Fachberichte und verrechnen die erbrachten Leistungen

Anforderungen:
• Sie verfügen über einen Studienabschluss in Psychologie auf Masterstufe

• Sie besitzen eine fundierte klinische Ausbildung im Bereich Kinder- und Jugendpsychologie und eine abgeschlossene oder fortgeschrittene psychotherapeutische Weiterbildung

• Sie bringen grosse Freude an der systemischen Arbeit mit Kindern, Jugendlichen und dem Bezugssystem mit.

• Sie verfügen über eine hohe Selbständigkeit, können Zusammenhänge erkennen und entsprechende Lösungen angehen.

• Sie besitzen Eigeninitiative, gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der nötigen Prise Humor sowie einen geschickten Umgang mit psychischen Belastungen

• Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Anwendungen

Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software "Moodtalk" an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Per rafforzare i nostri team negli ambulatori della Clinica di psichiatria e psicoterapia infantile e dell'adolescenza di Aarau o Rheinfelden, cerchiamo voi per svolgere immediatamente o su appuntamento i seguenti compiti:
• Lavori in un team interdisciplinare impegnato presso l'ambulatorio in conformità con gli obiettivi istituzionali
• Ti occupi autonomamente della gestione dei casi e svolgi valutazioni, psicoterapia, interventi di crisi e consultazioni con bambini e giovani mentalmente stressati e le loro famiglie
• Effettui valutazioni psichiatrico-psicologiche utilizzando strumenti standard (risultati psicopatologici, test psicologici, anamnesi, informazioni di terzi)
• Preparate diagnosi e valutazioni secondo lo schema diagnostico valido e, sulla base di questo, sviluppate un piano d'azione secondo metodi stabiliti professionalmente, basati su linee guida e tenendo conto delle circostanze individuali dei bambini/giovani
• Redigere la documentazione necessaria per il trattamento, le relazioni tecniche e la fattura per i servizi forniti. Requisiti:
• Hai un master in psicologia
• Possiedi una solida formazione clinica nel campo della psicologia infantile e dell'adolescenza e una formazione psicoterapeutica completa o avanzata
• Ti piace lavorare in modo sistematico con i bambini, i giovani e il sistema di riferimento.
• Possiedi un elevato livello di indipendenza, sai riconoscere le connessioni e approcciare soluzioni adeguate.
• Hai iniziativa, buone capacità di comunicazione con il necessario tocco di umorismo e un'abile capacità di affrontare lo stress psicologico
• Sei sicuro di utilizzare le comuni applicazioni di Office. Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Proprio per questo ti offriamo molto: incoraggiamo fortemente la formazione continua. Investiamo molto anche nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Offriamo anche sconti interessanti su marchi rinomati come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che si spostano da noi con i mezzi pubblici ricevono a fine anno un impressionante ecobonus. Offriamo anche un'interessante soluzione di cassa pensione. Promuoviamo inoltre l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo la possibilità di acquistare una vacanza.

Descrizione In order to strengthen our teams in the Aarau or Rheinfelden ambulatories of the clinic for children and adolescent psychiatry and psychotherapy, we look for you as tasks - you work in a committed interdisciplinary team of the ambulatorium according to institutional objectives - you independently take over the case management and carry out clarifications, psychotherapies, crisis interventions and consultations with mentally burdened children and adolescents and their families - you carry out psychiatric psychological clarifications with the common instruments (psychopathological assessment, test psychology, medical history, third-party information) - You prepare diagnoses and assessments according to the valid diagnosis scheme and work on this basis a planning of measures according to technically established, guideline-oriented methods and taking into account the individual circumstances of the children / adolescents - You prepare the necessary treatment documentation and specialist reports and calculate the performance requirements - You have a degree in psychology at master level - You have a well-founded clinical training in the field of child and adolescent psychology and a completed or advanced psychotherapeutic training - You bring great pleasure in the - You have a high degree of independence, can identify connections and tackle appropriate solutions. - You have initiative, good communication skills with the necessary touch of humor and a skilful handling of psychological stress - you are confident in dealing with the common office applications
• Cosa offriamo Our employees are the heart of our company. This is exactly why we offer you a lot: - Further education is strongly promoted by us. - We also invest heavily in team cohesion and offer all our teams access to the software "Moodtalk", which strengthens team communication. - In addition, we offer attractive discounts on well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. - Employees who commute to us by public transport will receive a handsome eco-bonus at the end of the year. - In addition, we offer an attractive pension fund solution. - We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy holidays.

• Lei sostiene e promuove le capacità sociali ed emotive e le capacità dei pazienti (età da 7 a ≤ 18 anni) nell'impostazione milieutherapeutica. Progettare la struttura quotidiana dei pazienti in collaborazione con il team e le altre aree specializzate
• In situazioni di emergenza, si agisce in modo competente e fornire sicurezza per i bambini e i giovani. Sei responsabile dell'attuazione dei requisiti di pianificazione del trattamento:
• Hai un'educazione completata con successo nella pedagogia sociale e hai già esperienza professionale, con esperienza psichiatrica vantaggio
• Hai esperienza di lavoro con bambini e adolescenti
• Sei flessibile, impegnato, resiliente e una persona responsabile con piacere nella cura paziente esigente in una vivace azienda
• Si parla o scrivere fluente tedesco e avere una gestione sicura delle applicazioni di ufficio comuni Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti sono il cuore della nostra azienda. Questo è proprio il motivo per cui vi offriamo molto: ulteriore istruzione è fortemente promossa qui. Investiamo anche molto nella coesione del team e offriamo a tutti i nostri team l'accesso al software "Moodtalk", che rafforza la comunicazione del team. Inoltre, offriamo interessanti sconti per marchi noti come Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl e molti altri. I dipendenti che ci commutano con i mezzi pubblici riceveranno un bel eco-bonus alla fine dell'anno. Inoltre, offriamo una soluzione di fondo pensione attraente. Promuoviamo anche l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa: Siamo sempre aperti al lavoro part-time e offriamo l'opportunità di acquistare vacanze.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to strengthen our teams in care and social pedagogy, we are looking at our therapy unit of the Clinic for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry as of 01. June 2026 or by appointment You as tasks:
• You support and promote the social and emotional skills and abilities of patients (age from 7 to ≤ 18 years) in the milieutherapeutic setting. You design the daily structure of the patients in cooperation with the team and the other specialist areas
• In emergency situations, you act competently and provide safety for children and young people. You are jointly responsible for the implementation of treatment planning requirements:
• You have a successfully completed education in social pedagogy and already have professional experience, with advantage psychiatric experience
• You have experience working with children and adolescents
• You are flexible, committed, resilient and a responsible person with pleasure in demanding patient care in a lively company
• You speak or write fluent German and have a secure handling of the common office applications We offer: Our employees are the heart of our company. This is precisely why we offer you a lot: further education is strongly promoted here. We also invest a lot in team cohesion and offer all our teams access to the software "Moodtalk", which strengthens team communication. In addition, we offer attractive discounts for well-known brands such as Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl and many more. Employees who commute to us by public transport will receive a handsome eco-bonus at the end of the year. In addition, we offer an attractive pension fund solution. We also promote work-life balance: We are always open to part-time work and offer the opportunity to buy holidays.
